deliveryProcessing.policy: Deterministic hash-pinned source selection, resampling, low-pass, endpoint, and peak treatment for frequent or spectrally sharp cues; no synthesized layer and no provider request.

signatureDeliveryProcessing.policy: Hash-pinned source selection, channel fold, resampling, low-pass, endpoint fades, and conservative peak normalization only; no synthesized layer and no provider request.

crowdedMixAudit.method: Four-times windowed-sinc true-peak estimate over decoded AAC deliveries at exact runtime gains; dry effects bus, centered sources.
